patch_description: This ansatz replaces the underperforming pair of collective RX/RY mixers with a symmetry-regularized correlation processor. A shared RY basis change is followed by a parameter-free Möbius CZ network, then interleaved ZZ and YY rotations on every ring edge. The orthogonal Ising channels generate noncommuting correlations across adjacent edges, increasing useful expressivity while retaining only one distinct circuit parameter. This preserves strong parameter efficiency and few-shot regularization while targeting harder validation groups through richer two-qubit correlation transport.
